issue_description: The customer's washing machine stopped working with error code E21 and the drum does not spin. After a technician visit and a missed second visit, the issue remains unresolved and the customer demands a full replacement.
The customer was double charged for her broadband bill for the month of August 2026. The duplicate amount has since been credited back to her card.

The customer's laptop order has been delayed past the promised delivery date and has been stuck at the Hyderabad hub for six days. The customer was previously promised an update within 48 hours by a chat agent on 10 September 2026, but no update has been received.

The customer is unable to log in to her PayWise account following the app update on 11 September 2026, receiving a "Session expired, please try again" error after entering the OTP. She is concerned because her electricity bill auto-pay is due on 20 September.
The customer is inquiring about the possibility of purchasing an extended warranty for their refrigerator, along with the cost, coverage details, and whether the compressor is included.

The customer returned a pair of running shoes on 12 August 2026 which was received at the warehouse on 16 August 2026. More than four weeks have passed without receiving the promised refund despite multiple follow-ups.
